overview_description.description: Appro is a retail banking onboarding powerhouse that offers a quick and simple application process. Appro is a software platform used by organizations to manage internal approval workflows and requests. It allows users to submit, review, and track documents or tasks across departments. The system records status updates and maintains logs of approval steps. It is used for structuring administrative processes such as leave requests, purchases, and operational permissions within a centralized interface for coordination and record keeping across organizational workflows and documentation systems daily use.
